FVNT.name: FVNT
FVNT.note: UNOX 3/8 NO solenoid (info); target CdA (sheet FVNT)

OFD.name: OFD
OFD.note: Same valve as OVNT (Jaksa 2/2 cryo solenoid)

assumptions.vent_gas: Nitrogen; the FullFlow config identifies nitrogen as the pressurant.
assumptions.vent_process: Adiabatic ideal-gas blowdown to ambient through the valve CdA; no piping restriction, heat transfer, or two-phase flow.
assumptions.drain_process: Incompressible LOX discharge to ambient at the listed fixed ullage gauge pressures; no flashing, piping restriction, or outlet back-pressure.
assumptions.tank_inside_diameter_in: FullFlow notes 8.5 in OD. This isolated drain model uses 8.5 in as an unverified effective ID.
